prompt: A sign-in form: email and password, a "Keep me signed in" option, a submit button, and a "Forgot password?" link. Show an error under the email field when it is empty on submit.
A team settings page: a heading, and a table of members with name, email, role and a remove button per row. Above the table, an "Invite" button.
A "Delete project" button that opens a confirmation before deleting. The confirmation says what will be lost and has Cancel and Delete.
A profile form with a display name and a bio. On save, tell the person it worked with a short message that goes away on its own.
A text editor's formatting bar: bold, italic and underline toggles that show only icons, and an alignment choice of left, center or right.
A projects page whose list is empty: a message that there are no projects yet and a button to create the first one, all inside a card.
A product search bar with a search field, a category picker (All, Books, Music, Games), an "In stock only" switch and a price range slider.
A task form with a title and a due date the person picks from a calendar, then a Save button.
A command palette that opens with Ctrl+K: a search box and a filtered list of actions (New file, Open settings, Invite people, Sign out) that run when picked.
A three-step sign-up wizard: account, profile, then confirm. It shows which step you're on, with Back and Next buttons, and Finish on the last step.
A row of three icon-only buttons (edit, duplicate, delete) for a document, each with a tooltip that says what it does.
An orders table with order number, customer, date and total. The columns can be sorted, and it shows 10 orders a page with page controls under it.
A settings page with tabs for General, Notifications and Billing. General has a display name field, Notifications has an email-updates switch, and Billing shows the current plan.
